58655a74cd.why: The narrow loads, transpose shuffles, stores, pointer updates and final comparison all contribute to preserved state.

ba9a9664ba.why: Each byte unpack needs a zeroed destination under SSSE3, and all eight unpacked vectors plus the zero register must be preserved.

02d7fe85d8.why: Broadcasting the low word requires both shuffle operations at this ISA level, and all four scalar operations produce required register values.

2c4367ee02.why: Both dot-product paths and their intermediate register results are preserved, and the arbitrary coefficients and clamp operands do not permit narrower arithmetic shortcuts.

520df2c793.why: The dot products, inserted word, duplicated load, clipping and final alignment all contribute to required register values or stores.

46c77dcd55.why: The reduction must preserve all four lanes of xmm0, including the doubled upper-lane sums, so a shorter ordinary horizontal sum would change the result.

ad2c26f7fa.why: The dword shift, unsigned high-word multiply and final word shift perform distinct truncations for arbitrary inputs.

add99f29eb.why: The magnitude multiply and sign restoration preserve rounding and signed-word edge cases that a direct signed multiply would change, while every store and register update is required.

6eb7199c31.why: Both clipped vectors and the signed input in xmm5 are preserved, and combining the nested sign operations would change the -32768 case.

99a866b433.why: The rounded magnitude and sign operations are needed for unrestricted inputs, and the pointer addition also supplies the preserved carry flag through the final decrement.

5af7f415ed.why: The repeated groups compute four separate stored vectors, and simplifying their magnitude and sign operations would change rounding or signed-word edge cases.

1dd4bb990c.why: Combining words before the signed multiply-adds would change overflow behavior, and the remaining widened sums, packing, stores and scalar updates are required.

243062456f.why: Both 16-byte stores and all three register updates are required, with no wider store available at this ISA level.

abdf490fed.why: The copy preserves the unpacked sum in xmm2 while xmm0 is saturated and packed, and both results plus the accumulator are required.

a77ddd2944.why: Both the saturated packed output and the unpacked sum are live, so eliminating the copy requires an additional copy or shuffle elsewhere.

c771a81167.why: Both loads and signed multiply-adds are needed for unrestricted words, followed by their sum and the comparison that produces the required flags.

bd2917b66f.why: Adding the source words before multiplication would lose signed overflow information, so both widened products and their sum are necessary.

45c465e883.why: The two independent signed multiply-add results require separate loads and multiplication operations before the dword sum.

6b2a867560.why: Arbitrary signed source words prevent moving addition before multiplication, leaving two loads, two multiply-adds and one dword addition.

739e0917b3.why: The accumulator copy is needed because both packed vectors and the full dword sums in xmm2, xmm4 and xmm6 must survive.
